{{Quote|Is that so difficult to believe, Captain Solo? Yes, we have destroyed the other suspects: Hondo Bador, Cabot Lom, Nevid d'Hon, Berille Ada&mdash;anyone Mama might have angered by helping you.|Craitheus Qreph|<ref name="Cn">[[Crucible (novel)|''Crucible'']]</ref>}}
'''Berrille Ada''' was a [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Spider/Legends|arachnid]] that worked as an outfitter during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. Ada maintained an office across the speederway from [[Mama's]] on [[Ord Mantell/Legends|Ord Mantell]], doing business with [[Smuggler/Legends|smugglers]] via a [[Berrille Ada's translator|translator]]. When [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] consulted [[Mama (information broker)|Mama]] about the identity of [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa's]] kidnapper, Berrille Ada was one of the outfitters she recommended he contact for further investigation.<ref name="SL" />

In [[45 ABY]], [[Marvid Qreph|Marvid]] and [[Craitheus Qreph]] told Han Solo that they had "destroyed" Berrille Ada along with all the others they suspected could have shot Mama&mdash;by which they meant that they had taken away its friends and family, and taken possession of Berrille Ada's private property.<ref name="Cn" />
